title: Pivot rows to columns — CASE (Sql)
description: Conditional aggregation pivots quarterly rows into quarter columns: SUM(CASE WHEN ...) totals each quarter separately in one pass.
how_it_works: Each CASE yields the amount only for its quarter, else zero; SUM collapses to one row.

test_cases.note: Determinism check: re-running the snippet reproduces the identical output.

pitfalls: The FILTER clause is cleaner where supported, but CASE works everywhere. Reproduce it once on purpose in a scratch file: seeing the failure teaches the fix faster than reading about it.

demo.title: Runnable code demo — Pivot rows to columns — CASE (Sql)
demo.program:
# JAH demo program — jahdb-demo-1.0
# Database: code-database · Record: JAH-CODE-0000016
# RUN: PC: save as demo.sql, run `sqlite3 :memory: < demo.sql`.

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN q = 'Q1' THEN amt ELSE 0 END) AS q1,
       SUM(CASE WHEN q = 'Q2' THEN amt ELSE 0 END) AS q2
FROM sales;
